PROJECT DESCRIPTION: A three hundred four (304) unit general occupancy rental apartment community will be acquired and rehabilitated.
All units will be affordable, and rents will be restricted for forty (40) years.

The Project will be income-restricted to households earning at or below seventy percent (70%) of the Area Median Income ("AMI").
Of the three hundred four (304) units, sixteen (16) units will be designated for residents with mobility impairments, and seven (7) units will be reserved for residents with sensory impairments.
